# Import Libraries
```{r import-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

# Import Data
```{r import-data}
dfWOD <- read_csv("Data/Clean/WorldOceans/01-Clean-WorldOceanData.csv") 

dfCoords <- read_csv("Data/Clean/WorldOceans/RegionsCoordinates.csv")

```

# Data Wrangling
## Traditional Wrangling
```{r data-wrangling}
# do some basic editing: date format, add in iron value that doesn't wanna import
dfWOD_edit <- dfWOD %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")) %>%
  mutate(`Iron (mg/L)` = ifelse(`Silicate (µmol/kg)` == "0.21", "0.024", `Iron (mg/L)`))

# make dataframe of just Diane Marshall Islands data because it's in a different format than rest of data
dfMarshalls <- dfWOD_edit %>%
  filter(Date == "2024-08-29")
# change column names to correct units
colnames(dfMarshalls) <- c("Date", "Ocean", "Region", "Location", "Depth (m)", "Temperature (ºC)",
                           "Salinity (PSU)", "Phosphate (mg/L)", "Silicate (mg/L)", "Nitrate (mg/L)",
                           "pH", "Chlorophyll (µg/L)", "Alkalinity (mg/L)", 
                           "Dissolved Organic Carbon (µmol/kg)", "Iron (mg/L)")

# convert data to units that will match B2 data
dfWOD_edit <- dfWOD_edit %>%
  # make sure Marshall's data isn't in there
  filter(Date < "2024-08-29") %>%
  # convert from µmol/kg of each compound into mg/L using average density of seawater at sealevel (1.025 kg/L) and the molecular weight of each compound (ex: phosphate = [PO4]3- = 94.973 g/mol)
  mutate(`Phosphate (mg/L)` = `Phosphate (µmol/kg)` * 1.025 * 94.973 / 1000000000,
         `Silicate (mg/L)` = `Silicate (µmol/kg)` * 1.025 * 76.08 / 1000000000,
         `Nitrate (mg/L)` = `Nitrate (µmol/kg)` * 1.025 * 62.0049 / 1000000000) %>%
  select(-`Phosphate (µmol/kg)`, -`Silicate (µmol/kg)`, -`Nitrate (µmol/kg)`) %>%
  rename(`Alkalinity (mg/L)` = `Alkalinity (µEq/L)`) %>%
  relocate(contains(c("Phosphate (mg/L)", "Silicate (mg/L)", "Nitrate (mg/L)")), .after = `Salinity (PSU)`)

# combine dataframes
dfWOD_combo <- rbind(dfWOD_edit, dfMarshalls)

```

## Adding Info
```{r add-countries}
dfWOD_final <- dfWOD_combo %>%
  mutate(Latitude = NA,
         Longitude = NA)

locations <- unique(dfWOD_combo$Location)

for (i in locations) {
 dfWOD_final <- dfWOD_final %>%
   mutate(Latitude = ifelse(Location == i, dfCoords[dfCoords$Region == i, 2], Latitude),
          Longitude = ifelse(Location == i, dfCoords[dfCoords$Region == i, 3], Longitude))
}

dfWOD_final <- dfWOD_final %>%
  mutate(`Iron (mg/L)` = as.numeric(`Iron (mg/L)`),
         Latitude = as.numeric(Latitude),
         Longitude = as.numeric(Longitude))

```


# Write Data
```{r write-data}
write_csv(dfWOD_final,
          file = "Data/Clean/WorldOceans/02-Clean-WorldOceanData-Final.csv")
```
